info.title: AdsEra REST API
info.description: Welcome to the AdsEra REST API. Use our API to integrate powerful, multi-channel communication (Email and WhatsApp) directly into your applications. Automate transactional messages, trigger marketing campaigns, manage your audience, and track performance programmatically.

post.description:
Initiates a new outbound WhatsApp voice call to a contact. Creates a `WaCall` record and a linked `WhatsAppMsg` of type `call` in the conversation thread. The `callId` returned should be used for all subsequent call operations.

**Requirements:**
- The contact must already exist in AdsEra, and must have accepted a call permission request (send a call permission template first).
- Calling is not available on Coexistence numbers.
- To receive **inbound** calls through the API, set the number's **Call handling** to **API** in AdsEra (Numbers → the number → Call handling).

parameters.name: whatsapp
parameters.description: The `_id` of the WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) to call from.

200.description: Call initiated successfully. Use the returned `callId` for accept/end operations.

400.description: Bad Request. A required field is missing or the phone number is invalid.

404.description: Not Found. The contact or WhatsApp account does not exist.

500.description: Internal Server Error or Meta API failure.

example.msg: Unable to establish connection with Meta.

post.description: Sends a WebRTC SDP answer to Meta before formally accepting an inbound call. Transitions the call status to `CONNECTING`. This must be called before `/accept` during inbound call negotiation.

200.description: SDP answer sent. Call status is now `CONNECTING`.

post.description: Formally accepts an inbound WhatsApp call. Transitions the call status to `CONNECTED` and records the `startTimestamp`.
Terminates an active WhatsApp call. Transitions the call status to `END` and records the `endTimestamp`. This endpoint does not require plan validation and can always be called to terminate a call.

500.description: Internal Server Error or Meta API failure.

example.error: Unable to terminate call with Meta.

post.description:
Same as **Send a Template Message**, but the template values go straight into the body instead of inside `dynamicData`.

```json
{ "template": "60c7…", "phone": "+919876543210", "firstname": "Riya", "order_id": "1042" }
```

`template`, `phone` and `whatsapp` are reserved. Every other key is a template value:
- variables by name (case-insensitive), e.g. `{{1}}` → `"1"`, `{{firstname}}` → `"firstname"`;
- `header_handle`, `location`, `otpCode`, `coupon_code`, `expiration_time_ms`, `flow_action`, carousel `card_0_…` keys and the rest, exactly as in v1 `dynamicData`.

Variables you leave out are filled from the contact's attributes when they match. v1 keeps working unchanged.

200.description: Message successfully queued. The message object is returned.

dynamicData.description:
Values for the template. Variables are matched by name (case-insensitive), e.g. `{{1}}` → `"1"`, `{{name}}` → `"name"`. Variables you leave out are filled from the contact's attributes when they match.

- `header_handle`: public URL of the header image, video or document; `filename` for a document header.
- `header`: header text parameters, for a text header with a variable.
- `location`: `{ latitude, longitude, name, address }` for a location header.
- `otpCode`: the code, required for AUTHENTICATION templates.
- `coupon_code`: for a Copy Offer Code button.
- `expiration_time_ms` (or `lto.expiration_time_ms`): offer expiry for Limited-time offer templates.
- `product_retailer_id` + `catalog_id`: the product for a product (SPM) header.
- `catalog.thumbnail_product_retailer_id`: thumbnail for a Catalog button.
- `mpm_action`: the sections/products action object for a multi-product (MPM) button.
- `flow_action`: `{ flow_token, flow_action_data }` for a WhatsApp Flow button.
- `order_detail_action`: the order details for a Pay Now (Review and Pay) button.
- Carousel cards: `card_{index}_header_handle`, `card_{index}_{variable}` (e.g. `card_0_1`), `card_{index}_product_retailer_id`, `card_{index}_catalog_id`. Index starts at 0.
